modes.label: None
modes.description: Nothing about how to work: the agent follows the project's own instructions.

modes.label: Direct
modes.description: The agent does the work itself, in the session you talk to.

modes.label: Doer-checker
modes.description: The agent does the work itself; RS's checker subagent reviews the plan before any code is written and the change before it is committed. Lighter than planner-doer-checker.

modes.label: Planner-doer-checker
modes.description: The agent plans with you; RS's doer subagent implements each unit and its checker subagent reviews it before it lands. More thorough, and it costs more tokens and time per unit.
